Coram : J.S. KHEHAR*, ARUN MISHRA
Uttaranchal Government Servants (Criterion for C Recruitment by Promotion) Rules, 2004: Rule 1 (3) - Promotion from Group 'D' post to Group 'C' post - Held: Promotional posts under consideration do not require consultation with Public Service Commission and, as Rules would apply to promotional avenues under consideration. Rule 2 - Overriding effect - Held: Rule 2 of the 2004 Rules leaves no room for any doubt that the 2004 Rules have an overriding effect, notwithstanding anything to the contrary E contf!ined, in any other Service Rules promulgated
